string-array.name: dash_abs
string-array.item: ABS fault
Anti-lock braking is not working; the normal brakes still work.
Brake gently, keep extra distance and have it checked soon.

string-array.name: dash_acc_active
string-array.item: ACC active
Adaptive cruise control is keeping your speed and distance.
Keep your hands on the wheel and watch the road.

string-array.name: dash_acc_fault
string-array.item: ACC fault
Adaptive cruise control has a fault or is not available.
Drive without ACC and have the system checked.

string-array.name: dash_acc_speed
string-array.item: ACC set speed
The speed that adaptive cruise is keeping (for example 100 km/h).
Change it with the steering-wheel buttons.

string-array.name: dash_acc_standby
string-array.item: ACC standby
Adaptive cruise is ready but not active.
Switch it on with the steering-wheel buttons.

string-array.name: dash_airbag
string-array.item: Airbag (SRS) fault
A fault in the airbags or seat-belt pretensioners: they may not work in a crash.
Have it checked at a BYD service centre as soon as possible.

string-array.name: dash_avh
string-array.item: AUTO HOLD
Green: holding the car still after you stop. White: ready.
Press the accelerator to drive off.

string-array.name: dash_brake
string-array.item: Brake system warning
Brake fluid is low or the braking system has a fault.
Stop safely now and do not keep driving. Contact a BYD service centre.

string-array.name: dash_bsd
string-array.item: Blind spot detection
Blind spot monitoring status. Staying on can mean a fault.
Check your mirrors. If it stays on, have it checked.

string-array.name: dash_coolant
string-array.item: Motor coolant too hot
The motor coolant temperature is too high.
Park in a safe place until the light goes out.

string-array.name: dash_cruise
string-array.item: Cruise control
Cruise control is switched on.
Set a speed to start cruising.

string-array.name: dash_discharge
string-array.item: Discharge (V2L)
The car is powering an external device. A warning shows if discharging fails.
Unplug the device when you are finished.

string-array.name: dash_eco
string-array.item: ECO mode
Economy drive mode is on, for lower consumption.
No action needed.

string-array.name: dash_engine
string-array.item: Engine fault
The engine has a fault.
Park safely and contact a BYD service centre.

string-array.name: dash_epb
string-array.item: Electronic parking brake (EPB)
On while the parking brake is applied. Flashing means an EPB fault.
Release the parking brake before driving. If it flashes, contact service.

string-array.name: dash_esc
string-array.item: Stability control (ESC)
Flashing: ESC is working to keep the car stable. Steady: ESC fault.
When it flashes, ease off the accelerator. If it stays on, have it checked.

string-array.name: dash_esc_off
string-array.item: ESC OFF
Stability control has been switched off.
Turn ESC back on unless you are stuck in sand, snow or mud.

string-array.name: dash_esc_red
string-array.item: ESC system fault
The electronic stability control has a fault.
Drive carefully, avoid sharp turns and have it checked soon.

string-array.name: dash_ev
string-array.item: EV mode
The car is driving on electric power only.
No action needed.

string-array.name: dash_front_car
string-array.item: Vehicle ahead detected
The system has found a vehicle ahead to follow.
No action needed; keep a safe distance.

string-array.name: dash_hev
string-array.item: HEV mode
The car is using the engine and the electric motor together.
No action needed.

string-array.name: dash_high_beam
string-array.item: High beam
The main-beam headlights are on.
Dip them for oncoming traffic.

string-array.name: dash_hma
string-array.item: Smart high beam (HMA)
The high beam switches on and off automatically for other vehicles.
No action needed.

string-array.name: dash_hv_battery
string-array.item: High-voltage battery fault
The traction battery system has a fault.
Contact a BYD service centre for inspection as soon as possible.

string-array.name: dash_hv_overheat
string-array.item: High-voltage battery overheating
The traction battery is too hot. Flashing is serious.
Stop safely to let it cool. If it flashes, stop and leave the car.

string-array.name: dash_lda
string-array.item: Lane departure assist
Warns you when the car drifts out of its lane.
Stay in your lane and use the indicators when changing lanes.

string-array.name: dash_lka
string-array.item: Lane keeping assist
Gently steers the car back into its lane.
Keep your hands on the wheel.

string-array.name: dash_low_fuel
string-array.item: Low fuel
The fuel level is low.
Refuel soon.

string-array.name: dash_lv_power
string-array.item: 12V power system fault
A problem with the DC converter or the low-voltage (12V) system.
Turn off the A/C, fan and radio, pull over safely and contact service.

string-array.name: dash_master
string-array.item: Master warning
There is a message or fault on the instrument cluster.
Read the message on the cluster and follow it.

string-array.name: dash_mil
string-array.item: Engine emission fault
The engine management or emission system has detected a fault.
Have the engine checked at a BYD service centre.

string-array.name: dash_normal
string-array.item: NORMAL mode
The normal drive mode is on.
No action needed.

string-array.name: dash_oil_life
string-array.item: Engine oil
The engine oil needs changing, or the oil pressure is low.
Book an oil service. If it stays on while driving, stop the engine and check the oil.

string-array.name: dash_ok
string-array.item: OK (ready to drive)
The car is on and ready to drive.
Select D or R to start driving.

string-array.name: dash_powertrain
string-array.item: Powertrain fault
The drive system has a fault and power may be limited.
Avoid driving. Stop safely and contact a BYD service centre.

string-array.name: dash_rear_fog
string-array.item: Rear fog light
The rear fog light is on.
Use it only in fog or heavy rain; switch it off otherwise.

string-array.name: dash_set
string-array.item: Cruise speed set
Cruise control is holding the set speed.
Brake or press cancel to stop cruising.

string-array.name: dash_smart_key
string-array.item: Smart key warning
The key is not detected in the car. Flashing means its battery is low.
Bring the key inside the car, or replace its battery.

string-array.name: dash_sport
string-array.item: SPORT mode
Sport drive mode is on, for a quicker response.
No action needed.

string-array.name: dash_tja_active
string-array.item: TJA/ICA active
Traffic-jam / intelligent cruise assist is steering within the lane.
Keep your hands on the wheel at all times.

string-array.name: dash_tja_standby
string-array.item: TJA/ICA standby
Lane-centring assist is ready but not steering.
It starts when the lane and speed conditions are met.

string-array.name: dash_tpms
string-array.item: Tyre pressure warning
One or more tyres are under-inflated, leaking or too hot.
Slow down, check the tyre screen, then inflate or repair the tyre.

string-array.name: dash_tsr
string-array.item: Traffic sign recognition
Shows the speed limit the camera has recognised.
Keep to the speed limit.

string-array.name: privacy_sections
string-array.item: "On your device Voice training samples, settings, saved places, parking spots and energy records are stored only on this device. Speech recognition runs entirely on the device, so your voice never leaves it."

"Microphone The microphone is used only to hear your commands. The wake word listens continuously only when you switch it on. Audio is processed in memory and not kept, except the training samples you record yourself."

"Location Location is used for where you parked, saved places, weather and speed limits. For weather, street names and speed limits, the position (without your name or any ID) is sent to free public services: MET Norway and OpenStreetMap."
"Phone and car Your phone and your car talk directly over your own Wi-Fi or hotspot after you pair them with a code. Nothing passes through أحمد للبرمجة's servers."
"Accessibility SmartBYD's accessibility service is used only to press buttons on the car's own A/C screen and to open the settings pages you ask for. It does not collect your personal content."
"No tracking There are no accounts, no ads and no analytics. أحمد للبرمجة does not collect, sell or share your data."
"Your control You can delete training samples at any time, and uninstalling SmartBYD removes all its data from the device."
"Contact Questions about privacy: أحمد للبرمجة, WhatsApp ⁦+964 780 774 4244⁩."

"Limitation of liability To the extent the law allows, أحمد للبرمجة is not liable for damage caused by misuse of the app, distraction while driving, or faults in the vehicle."
"Changes and contact These terms may be updated with new versions of the app. To order the app: ⁦+964 780 774 4244⁩. WhatsApp: ⁦+964 780 774 4244⁩."
